note: ⛔ SNG-464. Two Mind strikes — a direct psychic attack and a thought-guided physical one. Erik: 'great psychic strikes, as well as using the mind like Sherlock Holmes for physical attacks with incredible accuracy and effect.'

abilities.name: Deduced Strike
abilities.narrationHints: They watch for one exchange without engaging, and then hit once — the buckle, the old break, the foot that carries the weight — and a much better fighter is suddenly on the ground wondering how.
abilities.description: Read a foe mid-fight and land an ordinary blow exactly where it does the most — thought aimed through a body, and it hits like a much stronger arm.
abilities.notFor: An enemy you have not read; anything you cannot physically reach; a contest that ends before you get a second round.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU MUST HAVE WATCHED THEM — one full exchange, or a known pattern from before
⚠️ IT IS AN ORDINARY BLOW, PLACED PERFECTLY — you still need a weapon or a hand and you still must reach
a foe who changes their pattern resets what you knew
the watching exchange is one you spent not attacking

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action that deals damage. It rolls 2d6. Ranks: rank 2 lets you call the effect, rank 3 reads and strikes in the same round.

sectFlavour.cogitant: YOU MODELLED THEM — their reach, their favoured side, the joint that has been hurt before.
sectFlavour.syllogist: YOU REASONED IT — a fighter who does that must also do this, and this is where it leaves them open.
sectFlavour.figurist: YOU READ THEIR FORM — every stance is an instance of a shape, and shapes have gaps.

tree.name: Read the Exchange
tree.grants: ⛔ SPEND ONE ROUND OF THE EXCHANGE READING RATHER THAN CONTESTING — you concede that round's momentum — and your NEXT strike lands where they are weakest: an old injury, a badly-set strap, the foot carrying the weight. ⚠️ IN SYSTEM TERMS: a forfeited round buys a large matchup edge on the following one.
tree.cannot: You give up a round to get it. Against someone who ends the contest in one blow, that round is fatal.

tree.name: Called Effect
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS A DECLARED OUTCOME. Name what the blow does as well as that it lands — the shield arm drops, the weapon goes, the knee gives, they cannot pursue. ⛔ It happens because you aimed at the thing that causes it.
tree.cannot: One declared effect, and it must be physically plausible from where you hit.

tree.name: Strike While Reading
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS TEMPO — THE POINT OF THE SKILL. You no longer forfeit the round: you read AND strike in the same exchange, so the edge arrives without the cost. ⚠️ Against someone you have fought before, it lands on the opening blow.
tree.cannot: A foe genuinely unlike anything you have met still costs you the reading round.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-464. Erik: 'a Mind character should be able to use the mind (LIKE SHERLOCK HOLMES) to perform PHYSICAL ATTACKS with incredible accuracy and effect — a combo ability powered by thought.' ⚠️ `nativeOrCombination: combination` — this is thought aimed through a body, and the sect flavours differ in HOW the answer is reached.
abilities._systemFit:
⛔ SNG-465, RE-AUTHORED ONTO THE EXISTING SKILL-BATTLE SYSTEM. Erik: 'it can be used in the SENSE ROUND, then again in the main action... I'm not sure we have the wiring for this effect. Plus at r3 you could strike during the sense round.'
⚠️ THE WIRING LARGELY EXISTS. `skill_battle_system.json` already runs multi-round exchanges with a MOMENTUM METER and a MATCHUP BONUS. ⛔ SO A READING ROUND IS A ROUND YOU FORFEIT: you concede that round's momentum and buy a large matchup edge on the next. r3 removes the forfeit — read and strike in the same exchange.
⚠️ WHAT CCODE STILL NEEDS TO WIRE: a declared 'read' action that skips contesting and banks a named bonus. That is one flag on the round, not a new subsystem.
abilities._rangeNote: ⚠️ Erik: 'I don't think we have a measured range to utilise — keep that part defined in the prose for now.' `range` removed from mechanic; reach is described in the text.

abilities.name: Psychic Lance
abilities.narrationHints: Nothing crosses the space between them. The target's head goes back as though struck, and there is no mark, and they are bleeding from the nose.
abilities.description: Drive a spike of focused thought straight into a mind at range — no vector, no contact, nothing to block, and it hurts exactly as much as being hit.
abilities.notFor: Anything without a mind; targets out of sight; hurting a body directly — this wounds the thinking and the body follows.

bounds.text: ⛔ NOTHING BLOCKS IT — no armour, no cover, no shield. It does not travel
⚠️ IT NEEDS A MIND. A construct, a corpse or a mechanism takes nothing
you must be able to see them, and they will know instantly who did it
⚠️ a mind that strikes back reaches you the same way — this is a duel neither party can hide from

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action that deals damage. It rolls 3d6. Ranks: rank 2 strikes two minds, rank 3 leaves the target unable to hold anything.

tree.name: The Spike
tree.grants: ⛔ DRIVE ONE SPIKE OF THOUGHT INTO A MIND IN SIGHT. Armour, cover and shields are irrelevant — nothing crosses the space, so nothing can be interposed.
tree.cannot: One mind, in sight. It needs a mind to hurt.

tree.name: Two at Once
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS TARGETS. Split the strike across two minds in sight without losing weight on either — or put both into one, for a great deal more.
tree.cannot: Two at most, and both must be in sight when you begin.

tree.name: Nothing Held
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS AFTERMATH. The struck mind cannot hold anything for a round — a sustained craft drops, a held action is lost, a spoken command comes out wrong. ⚠️ Against a caster this is worse than the wound.
tree.cannot: One round, and a mind holding nothing loses nothing.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-464. Erik: 'a Mind character should have some GREAT PSYCHIC STRIKES.' ⚠️ Mind's existing damage was Cutting Figure (1d6, figurist geometry) and Sustained Regard (1d6, attention). ⛔ NEITHER WAS A DIRECT PSYCHIC ATTACK — this is the tradition's straight ranged hit, and its defining property is that NOTHING CAN BE INTERPOSED.
abilities._rangeNote: ⚠️ SNG-465: measured `range` removed per Erik — reach stays in the prose ('any mind in sight').
